implementation: Named in-memory buckets in the Worker isolate

protected_endpoints.global: All /api/* requests: 100 per IP per 15 minutes
protected_endpoints.candidate_password_change: POST /api/auth/register: 10 per authenticated email per 15 minutes
protected_endpoints.referral_click: Referral visit/click: 20 per IP per 15 minutes
protected_endpoints.campaign_visit: Campaign visits: 40 per IP per minute

regression: PASS — auth-regression verifies 10 failed password attempts receive 401, the next receives 429, and a second IP remains usable
distributed_behavior: A Worker isolate restart or a different isolate can reset the in-memory bucket; this is a known edge-distribution limitation.
current_assessment: VERIFIED — authenticated Cloudflare dashboard shows one active combined edge rule; live contact and admin-stats bursts each produced Cloudflare 429 blocks, and health recovered after cooldown. Fine-grained route windows and isolate-distributed fallback remain Worker responsibilities on the Free plan.
provider_access: Cloudflare zone token verification is active; Rulesets and Rate Limiting API reads still return 403 with the supplied tokens.
owner_action: For finer-grained or programmatic changes, provide a Cloudflare token with zone Rulesets/Rate Limiting permission; the current combined rule is already configured and live-verified through the authenticated dashboard.
account_access: The supplied account token can read Pages, Worker versions/secrets and R2, but not zone Rulesets/Rate Limiting.
minimum_permission_required: A Cloudflare API token with zone Rulesets/Rate Limiting read and edit permission for payservice.top.
permission_reference: Cloudflare's zone rate-limiting API requires Zone WAF Write; account-level rate-limiting rulesets require Account WAF Write or Account Rulesets Write.

edge_rule.name: SwiftJob Sensitive API Burst Protection
